from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class TMP1075_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 16

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x0000,  # TEMP
            0x01: 0x00FF,  # CFGR
            0x02: 0x4B00,  # LLIM
            0x03: 0x5000,  # HLIM
            0x0F: 0x7500   # DIEID
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 1 and addr in [0x00, 0x0F]:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8
        return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr in [0x01, 0x02, 0x03]:  # RW registers
            if nbytes == 1:  # single-byte write
                self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | ((data & 0x00FF) << 8)
            else:  # full-width write
                self.regs[addr] = (data & 0xFFFF)
        elif addr in [0x0F]:  # RO register
            pass  # ignore writes
        else:
            if nbytes == 1:  # single-byte write
                self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) | (data & 0x00FF)
            else:  # full-width write
                self.regs[addr] = data
